units.la: 21 De foedere novo inter Deum & homines per Christum sancito.
units.tr: 21 | On the new covenant between God and men, sanctioned through Christ.

units.la: 22 De allegorijs, tropis, typis, de sensu grammatico, tropologico, allegorico, & anagogico: quando & quomodo illis utendum.
units.tr: 22 | On allegories, tropes and types, and on the grammatical, tropological, allegorical and anagogical senses: when and how each is to be used.

units.la: 23 De euangelij & sacerdotij Christi aeternitate ac perfectione: ex quo sacerdotij legalis, atque ipsius etiam legis patet imperfectio, & abrogatio.
units.tr: 23 | On the eternity and perfection of the gospel and of the priesthood of Christ: from which the imperfection and abrogation of the legal priesthood, and indeed of the law itself, is evident.

units.la: 24 De Christi maiestate, qua Deo patris aequalis est, & ad dexteram eius sedet.
units.tr: 24 | On the majesty of Christ, by which he is equal to God the Father, and sits at his right hand.

units.la: 25 Differentia ueteris & noui testamenti.
units.tr: 25 | The difference between the Old and New Testament.

units.la: 26 An Christus passus sit secundum diuinam naturam.
units.tr: 26 | Whether Christ suffered according to the divine nature.

units.la: 27 An extra uerbum Dei eius q; praedicationem diuina expectanda sit reuelatio. Vbi de uera ἐνθουσιασμῷ, spiritus Sancti, & Enthusiastarum, Anabaptistarumq; erroribus agitur.
units.tr: 27 | Whether divine revelation is to be expected outside the word of God and its preaching. Here the errors of true enthusiasm, of the Holy Spirit, and of the Enthusiasts and Anabaptists are discussed.

units.la: 28 De sacrificij Christi excellentia, & ingressu in Sancta Sanctorum, deq; eius usu & effectibus.
units.tr: 28 | On the excellence of Christ's sacrifice and his entry into the Holy of Holies, and on its use and effects.

units.la: 29 De sanctuario, tabernaculo, eiusq; dispositione, & variis ceremonijs typicis.
units.tr: 29 | On the sanctuary, the tabernacle, its arrangement, and the various typical ceremonies.

units.la: 30 De typis & allegorijs, earumq; usu genuino, de quo & cap.7.
units.tr: 30 | On types and allegories, and their genuine use, on which see also chap. 7.

units.la: 31 An Christus, qui semel oblatus & ingressus est sancta sanctorum, denuo moriatur & offeratur in missa, secundum nugas papistarum.
units.tr: 31 | Whether Christ, who was offered once and entered the Holy of Holies, is again put to death and offered in the mass, according to the trifles of the Papists.

units.la: 32 Legalium sacrificiorum imperfectio.
units.tr: 32 | The imperfection of the legal sacrifices.

units.la: 33 Christi triumphus de peccato, morte, Satana, ex Osee 13. cap.
units.tr: 33 | Christ's triumph over sin, death and Satan, from Hosea chap. 13.

units.la: 34 De peccato irremissibili & in spiritum Sanctum.
units.tr: 34 | On the sin that cannot be forgiven, and on sin against the Holy Spirit.

units.la: Loci partis tertiae:
units.tr: Loci partis tertiae:

units.la: 1 De iustificatione fidei & eius effectis.
units.tr: 1 On the justification by faith and its effects.

units.la: 2 De incredulitate & eius poena.
units.tr: 2 On unbelief and its punishment.

units.la: 3 Fides & peregrinatio patrum.
units.tr: 3 Faith and the pilgrimage of the fathers.

units.la: 4 De creatione mundi, & variis erroribus.
units.tr: 4 On the creation of the world, and various errors.

units.la: 5 De ciuitate Dei coelesti & aeterna, ad quam patres olim fidei oculos habuerunt fixos atq; intentos.
units.tr: 5 On the heavenly and eternal city of God, to which the fathers of old kept the eyes of their faith fixed and intent.

units.la: Loci partis quartae:
units.tr: Loci partis quartae:

units.la: 1 Exhortatio ad opera charitatis & fidei, sol.
units.tr: 1 Exhortation to works of charity and faith, namely the sun.

units.la: 2 Studium pacis & sanctimoniae.
units.tr: 2 The pursuit of peace and holiness.

units.la: 3 Beneficentia erga exules & pauperes atq; afflictos.
units.tr: 3 Beneficence towards exiles, the poor and the afflicted.

units.la: 4 Coniugij sanctitas & munditiess.
units.tr: 4 The sanctity and purity of marriage.

units.la: 5 Auaritia fugienda.
units.tr: 5 Avarice is to be shunned.

units.la: 6 Commendatio fidorum doctorum.
units.tr: 6 Commendation of faithful teachers.

units.la: 7 Variae & peregrinae doctrinae declinandae: ubi & Scripturarum utilitas exponitur.
units.tr: 7 Various and strange doctrines are to be avoided: where also the usefulness of the Scriptures is set forth.

units.la: 8 Doctoribus verbi Dei obediendum.
units.tr: 8 Obedience is to be shown to the teachers of God's Word.

units.la: Hisce coplures alij loci adiuncti sunt, quos pius ac diligens lector, non sine magno fructu, ex opere ipso excerpet, atque pro candore suo cuoluet.
units.tr: To these several other topics have been added, which the pious and diligent reader will draw out from the work itself, not without great profit, and will ponder in his own sincerity.

units.la: LOCI SCRIPTVRARVM SEORSIM, CANDIDE AC DILUCIDE SECUNDUM FIDEI ORTHODOXAE REGULAM EXPOSITI.
units.tr: THE PASSAGES OF SCRIPTURE SET OUT SEPARATELY, CLEARLY AND PLAINLY ACCORDING TO THE RULE OF THE ORTHODOX FAITH.

units.la: Loci in prima parte citati & explicati.
units.tr: Passages cited and explained in the first part.

units.la: 1 Psalm. 2. Quare fremuerunt gentes, &c. ubi de Christi regno, triumpho, iudicio, & hostium suppressione agitur, ac errores Rabinorum refutantur.
units.tr: 1 Psalm 2. Why do the nations rage, &c. Here the kingdom, triumph, judgment and subjection of the enemies of Christ are treated, and the errors of the Rabbis are refuted.

units.la: 2 1.Sam.7. Ego ero ei pater, & ille erit mihi filius.
units.tr: 2 1 Sam. 7. I will be his father, and he shall be my son.

units.la: 3 Psalm.96. Adorent eum omnes angeli Dei.
units.tr: 3 Psalm 96. Let all the angels of God worship him.

units.la: 4 Psalm.103. Qui creat angelos suos spiritus, & ministros suos ignis flammam.
units.tr: 4 Psalm 103. Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

units.la: 5 Psalm.44. Thronus tuus Deus in seculum seculi, virga rectitudinis virga regni tui, &c.
units.tr: 5 Psalm 44. Thy throne, O God, endures for ever and ever; the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness, &c.

units.la: 6 Psal.102. Et tu in initio Domine terrae fundamenta iecisti, et opera manuum tuarum sunt coeli, ipsi peribunt, etc.
units.tr: 6 Psalm 102. And thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of thy hands; they shall perish, etc.

units.la: 7 Psal.110. Sede a dextaris meis, donec posuero inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum, &c. sol.
units.tr: 7 Psalm 110. Sit at my right hand, until I make thy enemies a footstool for thy feet, &c. Solved.

units.la: 8 Psalm.8. Domine quam admirabile est nomen tuum, &c.
units.tr: 8 Psalm 8. O Lord, how excellent is thy name, &c.

units.la: 9 Psal.22. Annunciabo nomen tuum fratribus meis, &c.
units.tr: 9 Psalm 22. I will declare thy name to my brethren, &c.

units.la: 10 Esaiae 12. Ecce Deus saluator meus, fiducialiter agam, & non timebo: quia fortitudo & laus mea Dominus, & factus est mihi in salutem.
units.tr: 10 Isaiah 12. Behold, God is my saviour; I will trust and not be afraid, for the Lord is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation.

units.la: 11 Psal.17. Diligam te Domine, fortitudo mea, Dominus firmamentum meum, & refugium meum, & liberator meus, &c.
units.tr: 11 Psalm 17. I will love thee, O Lord, my strength; the Lord is my firmament, my refuge and my deliverer, &c.

units.la: 12 Esaiae 8. Ecce ego & pueri, quos dedisti mihi
units.tr: 12 Isaiah 8. Behold, I and the children whom thou hast given me.

units.la: 13 Deuteronom.18. Prophetam de gente tua, & de fratribus tuis, sicut me, suscitabit tibi Dominus Deus tuus, ipsum audies.
units.tr: 13 Deut. 18. The Lord thy God will raise up for thee a prophet from among thy own nation and from thy brethren, like unto me; him shalt thou hear.

units.la: 14 Psalm 94. Hodie si vocem eius audieritis, ne obdurętis corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatione, in die tentationis in deserto.
units.tr: 14 Psalm 94. Today, if you hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness.

units.la: Loci citati & seorsim tractati parte secunda.
units.tr: Passages cited and treated separately, part two.

units.la: 1 Psal.110. Tu es sacerdos in æternum, secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
units.tr: 1 Psalm 110. You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.

units.la: 2 Ezechiel.18. Si impius egerit pœnitentiā, &c. usq; ad, Oēs iustitiæ eius, quas fecerat, non recordabūtur.
units.tr: 2 Ezekiel 18. If the wicked man shall do penance, etc., down to: All his righteousnesses which he had done shall not be remembered.

units.la: 3 Genes.14. Historia de Abrahamo & Melchisedeco, deq; decimis tributis Melchisedeco.
units.tr: 3 Genesis 14. The history of Abraham and Melchizedek, and of the tithes paid to Melchizedek.

units.la: 4 Exod.25. Mosi forma tabernaculi in monte monstrata.
units.tr: 4 Exodus 25. The form of the tabernacle shown to Moses on the mount.

units.la: 5 Ieremiæ 31. Ecce dies venient, &c. ubi de novo fœdere est vaticinium.
units.tr: 5 Jeremiah 31. Behold, the days come, etc., where there is a prophecy of the new covenant.

units.la: 6 Exod.24. Obligatio populi Israelitici, qua Deo se obedientem fore obstringit.
units.tr: 6 Exodus 24. The obligation of the people of Israel, by which they bound themselves to be obedient to God.

units.la: 7 Psal.40. Sacrificium & oblationem noluisti, aures autē perforasti mihi: holocaustum & sacrificium pro peccato non postulasti, &c.
units.tr: 7 Psalm 40. Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; but mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering thou didst not require, etc.

units.la: 8 Deuteronom.19. Sub duobus aut tribus testibus, &c.
